title: 'This is the right one' - Rohl on leaving Rangers for Salzburg
summary: Danny Rohl has left Rangers to join Red Bull Salzburg, explaining the move will allow him to win trophies and develop young players at the Austrian club. The transfer reflects Salzburg's established role as a development hub and a desirable next step for ambitious managers.
content: Danny Rohl explains why he left Rangers for Red Bull Salzburg - where he hopes to win trophies and help develop young players.

zh.title: "这是正确的选择" - Rohl谈离开流浪者队加盟萨尔茨堡
zh.summary: 丹尼·罗尔离开流浪者队加盟奥地利红牛萨尔茨堡，他解释称此举将使他能够赢得锦标和在该俱乐部培养年轻球员。这笔转会反映了萨尔茨堡作为一个人才培养中心的既定角色，也是雄心勃勃的教练们的理想下一步。

title: Are fans now more invested in star names than clubs?
summary: The article examines whether young football fans are now more drawn to individual star players than club loyalty, citing examples like Messi, Ronaldo, Haaland, and Bellingham. This shift highlights how player power and personal fandom increasingly compete with traditional club identity.
content: From Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo to Erling Haaland and Jude Bellingham, are star names a bigger draw than clubs for young fans?

zh.title: 球迷现在是否更投入于明星球员而非球队？
zh.summary: 该文章探讨了年轻足球迷现在是否比俱乐部忠诚度更关注个别明星球员，引用了梅西、罗纳尔多、哈兰和贝林厄姆等例子。这种转变凸显了球员力量和个人粉丝效应如何日益与传统俱乐部认同相竞争。
